### `perf.semantic_cache` — Semantic Cache

Serves repeated and near-identical requests from memory: exact matches by hash, paraphrases by embedding similarity.

**Why it exists.** Interfaces ask the same questions constantly; paying for each one is waste and latency.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | direct: computed by the engine, no model call |
| Model tier | — |
| Surface | `service` — Invoked from application code, the CLI or the developer tools. |
| Binds to | any component, or call it from code |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `clear` | boolean | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `entries` | integer |
| `hits` | integer |
| `semanticHits` | integer |
| `misses` | integer |
| `hitRate` | number |

**Use it**

```python
# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("perf.semantic_cache", {})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "entries": 0,
  "hits": 0,
  "semanticHits": 0,
  "misses": 0,
  "hitRate": 0.0
}
```

### `perf.stream_scene` — Streaming Scenes

Renders interfaces progressively while the model is still writing, by repairing partial JSON into valid scenes.

**Why it exists.** A two-second wait for a full response feels slow; the same two seconds of visible progress feels fast.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | direct: computed by the engine, no model call |
| Model tier | — |
| Surface | `service` — Invoked from application code, the CLI or the developer tools. |
| Binds to | any component, or call it from code |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `partial` | string | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `ok` | boolean |
| `complete` | boolean |
| `value` | JSON value |

**Use it**

```python
# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("perf.stream_scene", {"partial": "{\"scene\": {\"type\": \"Page\", \"text\": \"Orders\", \"children\": [{\"type\": \"Stat\", \"text\": \"Reven"})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "complete": false,
  "value": "{\"scene\": {\"type\": \"Page\", \"text\": \"Orders\", \"children\": [{\"type\": \"Stat\", \"text\": \"Reven\"}]}}"
}
```

### `perf.router` — Model Router

Maps capability tiers to the best available model, discovering what the account can reach and falling back down a chain.

**Why it exists.** Model line-ups change every few months; applications should not need a release when they do.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | direct: computed by the engine, no model call |
| Model tier | — |
| Surface | `service` — Invoked from application code, the CLI or the developer tools. |
| Binds to | any component, or call it from code |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

_No fields._

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `live` | boolean |
| `discovered` | boolean |
| `tiers` | list of object {tier, model, chain} |

### `perf.speculate` — Speculative Precompute

Runs likely-next requests in the background so their results are already cached when asked for.

**Why it exists.** Prediction is cheap; perceived latency is expensive.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | direct: computed by the engine, no model call |
| Model tier | — |
| Surface | `service` — Invoked from application code, the CLI or the developer tools. |
| Binds to | any component, or call it from code |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `requests` | list of object {capability, input} | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `queued` | integer |

**Use it**

```python
# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("perf.speculate", {"requests": [{"capability": "content.title", "input": {"text": "Quarterly planning notes for the platform team."}}]})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "queued": 1
}
```

### `perf.reflex` — Reflex Path

Gives every capability a local, deterministic implementation that answers in milliseconds — offline, in tests, or while the model thinks.

**Why it exists.** An interface must stay useful without a network, a key or a budget.

### `perf.resilience` — Circuit Breaker & Backoff

Retries transient failures with backoff, opens a breaker on repeated ones, and fails over to the next model or Reflex.

**Why it exists.** A provider incident should make an interface slower or simpler, never broken.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | direct: computed by the engine, no model call |
| Model tier | — |

_No fields._

| `breakers` | list of object {model, state, failures} |

### `perf.digest` — Scene Digest Compression

Compresses a scene into a compact outline — structure, text, bindings — so screens fit in a prompt at a fraction of the tokens.

**Why it exists.** Sending raw UI trees to a model wastes most of the context window on presentation detail.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | direct: computed by the engine, no model call |
| Model tier | — |
| Surface | `service` — Invoked from application code, the CLI or the developer tools. |
| Binds to | any component, or call it from code |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scene` | any | no |
| `budget` | integer | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `digest` | string |
| `nodes` | integer |
| `chars` | integer |
| `ratio` | number |

**Use it**

```python
# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("perf.digest", {"scene": {"type": "Page", "props": {"title": "Orders"}, "children": [{"type": "Button", "id": "new", "props": {"…": "2 keys"}, "on": {"…": "1 keys"}}, {"type": "Hologram", "props": {"…": "1 keys"}}]}})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "digest": "Page \"Orders\"\n  Button #new \"New order\" @click→create_order\n  Text \"3D\"",
  "nodes": 3,
  "chars": 71,
  "ratio": 0.208
}
```

### `perf.coalesce` — Request Coalescing

**Why it exists.** Ten components asking the same question at load should cost one request.

### `perf.telemetry` — Cost & Latency Telemetry

### `perf.repair` — Structured-Output Self-Repair

Recovers truncated or malformed model output, validates it against the schema, and re-asks with the exact errors when needed.

**Why it exists.** One malformed response should not surface as a broken screen.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | direct: computed by the engine, no model call |
| Model tier | — |
| Surface | `service` — Invoked from application code, the CLI or the developer tools. |
| Binds to | any component, or call it from code |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | yes |
| `schema` | any | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `ok` | boolean |
| `value` | JSON value |
| `errors` | list of string |

**Use it**

```python
# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("perf.repair", {"text": "```json\n{\"title\": \"Summary\", \"bullets\": [\"one\", \"tw", "schema": {"title": "str", "bullets": ["str"]}})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "value": "{\"title\": \"Summary\", \"bullets\": [\"one\", \"tw\"]}",
  "errors": []
}
```

### `perf.negotiate` — Adaptive Parameter Negotiation

Learns each model's request dialect — token limits, instruction role, reasoning and response-format support — and adapts automatically.

**Why it exists.** Request parameters differ across model generations and compatible providers; hard-coding any one set breaks on the next.

### `perf.embed_index` — Embedding Index

A built-in vector store: index documents once, query by meaning, with local embeddings offline and model embeddings when live.

**Why it exists.** Semantic features need a vector index; most applications should not have to deploy one.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | direct: computed by the engine, no model call |
| Model tier | — |
